title: Giant-killers! Fleetwood knock out Arsenal
lead: A small club from the fourth division beat the Premier League champions in the Carabao Cup.
body: On Tuesday 27 October 2026, Fleetwood Town played against Arsenal in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup, also called the League Cup. Fleetwood play in League Two, the fourth division of English football. Arsenal are the Premier League champions.
Fleetwood scored first, in the 21st minute. Viktor Gyökeres equalised for Arsenal after half-time: 1-1. There was no winner after 90 minutes, so there was a penalty shoot-out.
Fleetwood's goalkeeper, Jay Lynch, saved a penalty, and a teenage defender, Conor Haughey, scored the last one. Fleetwood won 5-3 on penalties! The fans ran onto the pitch to celebrate.
It is the first time that the Premier League champions have lost to a fourth-division team in this cup. And a funny detail: Fleetwood's stadium is called Highbury – the name of Arsenal's old stadium!

title: Manchester City's perfect start is over
lead: After seven wins in seven games, Manchester City lost at Aston Villa. Now Arsenal are level with them at the top.
body: On Saturday 24 October 2026, Aston Villa beat Manchester City 2-1 at Villa Park. Nicolas Jackson scored both goals for Villa. Erling Haaland scored City's goal with a header.
Before this match, City had won all their seven league games. It was also their fourth defeat at Villa Park in four seasons!
The same day, Arsenal beat Everton 2-0. Now Arsenal and City both have 21 points. City are first because their goal difference is better.
Another surprise on Sunday: Bournemouth won 3-0 at Old Trafford against Manchester United. United are only 16th in the table.

title: The Women's Super League is getting bigger
lead: This season, England's top women's league has 14 teams instead of 12.
body: The Women's Super League (WSL) is the top division of women's football in England. This season, 2026-27, there are 14 teams in the league, not 12.
Three new clubs joined: Birmingham City and Crystal Palace, the top two teams of the second division (WSL2), and Charlton Athletic. Charlton won a play-off against Leicester City on penalties.
Manchester City are the champions from last season. After five games, at the start of October, they were top of the table with 15 points: five wins in five games!
Women's football is very popular in England. The biggest crowd so far this season was almost 30,000 people, for Arsenal against Manchester United.
